title: Silver trumpet embellished with gold · Carter 175
creator: Codex · geometry and textures written directly in code
method: Deterministic annular shells swept along a gently curved centerline; no Meshy generation
placement: Recorded in the burial chamber’s southeast corner under lamp 173. Displayed on the approach floor at the burial entrance for access; this is a teaching offset from the recorded findspot.
interpretation: Documented length, bell diameter, silver body and gold mouthpiece/border. A gentle 12 mm shaft bow, bell curvature, 0.5–0.6 mm wall thickness and aged silver patina are modeling choices. Color, metallic/roughness and normal maps are UV-attached and embedded in the GLB, with standalone PNGs in silver-trumpet-textures/. Reference-derived pointed calices, alternating dotted and hatched fields, gold garland, cartouche emblems and a simplified three-figure tableau. The fine inscriptions and unseen circumference are interpretive, not a facsimile. The painted wooden insert is a separate duplicated profile in silver-trumpet-core.glb, with solid end caps and its own painted pattern.
artwork: 128×128 code-drawn icon; not PixelLab or AI-generated artwork
